title: Larsen Rapid Set Flexible Grey Floor & Wall Tile Adhesive

breadcrumb.name: Larsen Rapid Set Flexible Grey Floor & Wall Tile Adhesive

description: Larsen Professional Rapid Set Flex Grey is a flexible, non slip, fast setting, cement based adhesive. It is ideal for fixing porcelain, ceramic and dark coloured stone tiles to the floor or wall in both interior and exterior locations. This adhesive can be used to fix tiles onto timber subfloors overboarded with 15mm exterior grade plywood along with heated screeds. The adhesive bed thickness can be 3-6mm with small isolated areas built up to 12mm. Gypsum Plaster must be sealed with Larsen Acrylic Primer prior to the application of cement based adhesives. For full installation and technical details please refer to the guide below.

title: LTP Grimex Heavy Duty Tile Cleaner 1 Litre

breadcrumb.name: LTP Grimex Heavy Duty Tile Cleaner 1 Litre

description: Intensive cleaner, effective for removing stains such as oil, grease, ingrained dirt, grime old wax layers and transit protection wax from all artificial and natural stone and tiles. Ideal for the restoration of artificial and natural tiles and floors. It is especially effective on stone, travertine, slate, terracotta, porcelain and quarry tiles. LTP Grimex helps remove stubborn stains and existing layers of sealant from floors and tiles. It is also suitable for the general maintenance cleaning of external driveways, patios and paths. Suitable for artificial and natural tiles and floors including travertine, limestone, sandstone, slate, marble, porcelain, granite, terracotta, quarry tiles, brick, external paving and driveways. To remove cement and grout stains you may find LTP Grout Stain Remover is a more effective alternative. Important: Test the solution on an inconspicuous area before general application. Any alkalinity remaining on surfaces treated with this product should be completely neutralised. This may be done with a little clean water applied by sponge.

title: LTP Grimex Heavy Duty Tile Cleaner

breadcrumb.name: LTP Grimex Heavy Duty Tile Cleaner

description:
Intensive cleaner, effective for removing stains such as oil, grease, ingrained dirt, grime old wax layers and transit protection wax from all artificial and natural stone and tiles. Ideal for the restoration of artificial and natural tiles and floors. It is especially effective on stone, travertine, slate, terracotta, porcelain and quarry tiles. LTP Grimex helps remove stubborn stains and existing layers of sealant from floors and tiles. It is also suitable for the general maintenance cleaning of external driveways, patios and paths.
Suitable for artificial and natural tiles and floors including travertine, limestone, sandstone, slate, marble, porcelain, granite, terracotta, quarry tiles, brick, external paving and driveways.
To remove cement and grout stains you may find LTP Grout Stain Remover is a more effective alternative.
Important: Test the solution on an inconspicuous area before general application. Any alkalinity remaining on surfaces treated with this product should be completely neutralised. This may be done with a little clean water applied by sponge.

title: Mosaic Mesh Backing Sheets
description:
High Grab Self Adhesive Mosaic Tile Backing Sheets
These 300x300mm backing sheets convert a flexible mosaic sheet into a more rigid form making them much easier to handle and achieve a professional level finish.
The 1.4mm thickness can also be used to slightly pack out the thickness of mosaic to match a marginally thicker plain tile if necessary.
Simply place the mosaic sheet face down on a flat surface, peel off the backing paper and stick the backing sheet to the rear of the mosaic. The strong hexagon shaped plastic mesh will then support the mosaic making it almost as easy to install as a solid tile.

title: DURA Original Anti-fracture Mat
description:
DURA Original Matting is an anti-fracture membrane that eliminates the risk of tiles cracking or becoming loose when installed upon a substrate which may be subject to lateral movement such as expansion or contraction, e.g. chipboard floors. It will also act as a decoupling membrane on substrates which are aged and exhibiting signs of movement such as cracked screeds by isolating the tiled surface from the foundation below. DURA Original can also be installed in wet rooms, steam rooms and bathrooms as a waterproof barrier when used in conjunction with the Durabase tape, providing a waterproof layer ensuring that any water sensitive substrates remain unaffected and the tile installation remains secure.
DURA Original is supplied by the 30m² Roll or by the M² in M² Increments, simply select the format you wish to purchase it in below and the quantity you wish to buy.

title: Wifi Electric Underfloor Heating Thermostat (White)
description:
Control your electric underfloor heating via an app on your wifi connected smart device, compatible with both IOS and Android the easy to use app allows you to control and program your heated floor from anywhere you have your device. Alternately this easy to use thermostat can be controlled from the colour touchscreen panel where you will find the intuitive user interface easy to use. This model features a modern white minimalist casing.
Key Features
Wifi controlled via easy to use app on either Android or IOS
Built in ambient room sensor as well as dedicated floor temperature sensor
4 Programmable periods a day allowing for differing temperature settings per programmable period
Key-lock protection and frost protection
Does not require seperate hub, multiple units controllable from single app.
Easy to install App, simply scan the QR Code in the manual to take you to the download page for your device.
Control up to 12 Thermostats from your App, giving you the ability to control all of your floors from any of your devices with the app installed. This can be operated from anywhere you have a data or wi-fi connection. The exact amount of controllable thermostats does depend upon your routers capacity, often this may be more than 12.

title: Larsen FiberFlex Semi-Rapid Set Grey Floor & Wall Tile Adhesive

breadcrumb.name: Larsen FiberFlex Semi-Rapid Set Grey Floor & Wall Tile Adhesive

description: Fiberflex Semi-Rapid Set Grey Floor & Wall Tile Adhesive is a flexible S1 rated adhesive that has been specially formulated to create a microfibre reinforced non-slip cement based adhesive with a slightly longer pot life and open time compared to our rapid set adhesive, this makes it ideal for those more demanding projects and very large format tiles, as well as dark coloured natural stone and external installations. An advanced GEL technology has been used to ensure a soft, thixotropic adhesive making it easy to use while retaining strength. The Fiberflex Semi-Rapid Set Grey Floor & Wall Tile Adhesive can be used with a bed of 3-12mm with up to 20mm in small isolated areas. Larsen Acrylic Primer should be used on all gypsum substrates and as required on other porous substrates. On more difficult substrates, Larsen Primer Grip 360 should be used. 6mm NoMorePly is a pre-primed tile backer board which provides a flat, stable surface ready for floor tiling. It is ideal for floors which may be susceptible to deflection or lateral movement, such as expansion and contraction. Ideal for strengthening chipboard floors, floorboards or tongue and groove-boarded floors. NoMorePly is very easy to use, simply cut boards to size using the NoMorePly scoring knife and then fix them into position with Mega Strength adhesive and NoMorePly screws.

As well as acoustic qualities, NoMorePly has thermal insulation properties which makes it an ideal choice when you need to strengthen a floor prior to using electric underfloor heating, which can be laid directly onto the boards prior to tiling. The 6mm depth of the boards means there is minimum disruption to the height of the floor, so as to not cause too much of a height difference between adjoining rooms. NoMorePly has a high impact resistance which means that it is very durable during transportation and unlikely to be damaged during installation. So whether it is a timber floor which needs added strength or it's an old floor which requires stabilizing, NoMorePly is the perfect choice both for durability and ease of use.
